gauge_group: 4D N=1 SU(5), one adjoint, canonical gauge kinetic terms, matter parity
field_content: N matter tens, N+r matter anti-fives, r matter fives, h Higgs five/antifive pairs
equations: One-loop gauge beta zero. Only the two full anomalous dimension matrices of matter antifives and Higgs antifives are constrained. All residuals normalized to gauge term 24 g^2/5 after removing loop factor.
no_other_cubic_sources: matter and Higgs parity opposite, adjoint even, Yukawa tensor D shared, independent adjoint couplings L and F, no further active singlet or matter coupling into either antifive
matching: One common SU5 Higgs projection Y. One 24 insertion splits the heavy matter rows; two-width SM transfer uses 1402. Bare bilinear can be independently oriented.
